### James, A Servant of God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/james-servant-god
Passage: James 1:1
Points:
- James humbly identifies himself as a servant of God and Christ rather than claiming status through his earthly kinship to Jesus.
- The brief introduction reflects James the brother of Jesus, who became a leader of the Jerusalem church and a man of deep prayer.
- The greeting to scattered tribes speaks to believers dispersed by persecution and living away from their true homeland.
- Christians today likewise live as exiles on earth, needing God's wisdom for how faith should act amid difficult circumstances.

### Purpose Filled - Encouragement Café - June 25
Author: Olivia Barnes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/purpose-filled-encouragement-cafe-june-25.html
Passage: James 1:1
Points:
- Disruptions to normal life and routines can tempt believers to feel as though they have lost their sense of purpose.
- James recognized his foundational identity and life purpose simply in being a servant of God and Jesus Christ.
- A Christian's call to servanthood remains completely unchanged regardless of shifting outward circumstances.
- Serving God takes place in everyday ordinary duties right where you are, rather than waiting for ideal conditions.
- Times of hardship and struggle provide valuable opportunities to live out faith and reflect Christ to others.
